history.sg_progress: The United Nations Logistics Base at Brindisi, Italy, will develop and formalize an internal standard operating procedure providing guidance on the reallocation of purchase orders in the context of mission liquidation. The standard operating procedure will be based on lessons learned from the MINUSMA purchase order diversion exercise and will define procedures for the early identification of purchase order status, formal confirmation by purchase order-owning missions of continued operational requirements, and standardized decision pathways for reallocation, diversion or disposal. The standard operating procedure will further delineate roles and responsibilities among all relevant stakeholders, including purchase order- owning and -acquiring missions, to ensure the timely and demand-driven redistribution of purchase orders. Furthermore, prior to each liquidation, relevant guidance will be communicated to the liquidating entity.
